description: The plot illustrates how four sources (Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files) vary as a function of input size. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 tokens with labeled ticks at 200, 400, 600, and 800 (the rightmost point corresponds to 1000). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40). The Tutorials series is a blue solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 23 at 200 tokens to ~27 at 500, reaching ~29 at 800, then slightly decreasing to ~28 at 1000. The Library Documentation series is a red solid line with circular markers, rising from ~26 at 200 to ~29 at 500 and ~32 at 800, then dropping to ~27 at 1000. The StackOverflow posts series is a yellow solid line with circular markers, starting near ~33 at 200, slightly decreasing to ~30 at 500, then declining to ~19 at 800 and further to ~11 at 1000. The Github files series is a green solid line with circular markers, increasing from ~28 at 200 to ~30 at 500 and ~33 at 800, then decreasing to ~29 at 1000.
